name: Vowelconsonantinterchangecipher

description_json.name: VowelConsonantInterchangeCipher
description_json.idea: A simple, highly deterministic substitution cipher that swaps vowels with vowels and consonants with consonants using a fixed, easy-to-compute mapping. Vowels (A, E, I, O, U) are shifted forward by 1 position in the vowel sequence (A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A). Consonants are shifted forward by 1 position in the consonant-only alphabet (B->C, C->D, ..., Z->B, skipping vowels). Case is preserved, and all non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), replace it with the next vowel in the sequence: A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A (preserve case).
2. If it is a consonant (any letter that is not A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), replace it with the next consonant in the alphabetical sequence of consonants: B->C, C->D, D->F, F->G, G->H, H->J, J->K, K->L, L->M, M->N, N->P, P->Q, Q->R, R->S, S->T, T->V, V->W, W->X, X->Y, Y->Z, Z->B (preserve case).
3. If it is not a letter (digits, spaces, punctuation), leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel, replace it with the previous vowel in the sequence: E->A, I->E, O->I, U->O, A->U (preserve case).
2. If it is a consonant, replace it with the previous consonant in the alphabetical sequence of consonants: C->B, D->C, F->D, G->F, H->G, J->H, K->J, L->K, M->L, N->M, P->N, Q->P, R->Q, S->R, T->S, W->V, X->W, Y->X, Z->Y, B->Z (preserve case).
3. If it is not a letter, leave it completely unchanged.
